*   The UserAgent function in the httpstate client package must return a string matching the pattern '^pulumi-cli/1 \([^()]*\)$'. When no command or AI agent has been set, the returned string must not contain 'cmd=' or 'agent='.

*   SetUserAgentCommand must be an exported function in the httpstate client package that accepts a command string and stores it as package-level state. When set to a non-empty value, subsequent calls to UserAgent must include '; cmd=<sanitized-value>' within the parenthesized section. Setting it to an empty string must remove the 'cmd=' segment from UserAgent output.

*   SetUserAgentAIAgent must be an exported function in the httpstate client package that accepts an AI agent name string and stores it as package-level state. When set to a non-empty value, subsequent calls to UserAgent must include '; agent=<value>' as the last token before the closing parenthesis. Setting it to an empty string must remove the 'agent=' segment from UserAgent output.

*   When both command and AI agent are set, UserAgent must include both fields: the command appears as '; cmd=<value>;' (with a trailing semicolon since agent follows), and the AI agent appears as '; agent=<value>)' at the end. The command must appear before the agent in the User-Agent string.

*   SetUserAgentCommand must sanitize the input value: leading and trailing whitespace is stripped, spaces and tabs are replaced with hyphens, and parentheses '(' ')' and semicolons ';' are removed. For example, 'weird (cmd; with) bits' must become 'weird-cmd-with-bits'.

*   DetectAIAgent must be an exported function (capitalized) in the pkg/cmd/pulumi/metadata package with the signature DetectAIAgent(getEnv func(string) string) string. It was previously unexported as detectAIAgent and must be renamed to be accessible from other packages.

*   DetectAIAgent must detect AI coding environments from well-known environment variables, including those for Copilot (COPILOT_MODEL, COPILOT_ALLOW_ALL, COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN), Codex (CODEX_THREAD_ID, CODEX_SANDBOX, CODEX_CI), Cursor (CURSOR_TRACE_ID, CURSOR_AGENT), Gemini CLI (GEMINI_CLI), Antigravity (ANTIGRAVITY_AGENT), Augment (AUGMENT_AGENT), OpenCode (OPENCODE, OPENCODE_CALLER, OPENCODE_CLIENT), Claude Code with cowork mode (CLAUDE_CODE_IS_COWORK taking precedence over CLAUDECODE/CLAUDE_CODE), Replit (REPL_ID), and Goose (GOOSE_PROVIDER). An explicit AI_AGENT environment variable must take precedence over all auto-detected values.

134	// addPulumiCLIMetadataToEnvironment enriches updates with metadata to provide context about
135	// the system, environment, and options that an update is being performed with.
136	func addPulumiCLIMetadataToEnvironment(env map[string]string, flags *pflag.FlagSet, getEnviron func() []string) {
137		// Pulumi Environment Variables (Name and Set/Truthiness Only)
138	
139		// Set up a map of all known bool environment variables.
140		boolVars := map[string]struct{}{}
141		for _, e := range declared.Variables() {
142			_, ok := e.Value.(declared.BoolValue)
143			if !ok {
144				continue
145			}
146			boolVars[e.Name()] = struct{}{}
147		}
148	
149		// Add all environment variables that start with "PULUMI_" and their set-ness or truthiness.
150		for _, envvar := range getEnviron() {
151			if !strings.HasPrefix(envvar, "PULUMI_") {
152				// Not a Pulumi environment variable. Skip.
153				continue
154			}
155			name, value, ok := strings.Cut(envvar, "=")
156			if !ok {
157				// Invalid environment variable. Skip.
158				continue
159			}
160			flag := "set"
161			if _, isBoolVar := boolVars[name]; isBoolVar {
162				flag = "false"
163				if cmdutil.IsTruthy(value) {
164					flag = "true"
165				}
166			}
167	
168			// Only store the variable name and set-ness or truthiness not the value.
169			env["pulumi.env."+name] = flag
170		}
171	
172		// System information
173		env["pulumi.version"] = version.Version
174		env["pulumi.os"] = runtime.GOOS
175		env["pulumi.arch"] = runtime.GOARCH
176	
177		// Guard against nil pointer dereference.
178		if flags == nil {
179			// No command was provided. Don't add flags.
180			return
181		}
182	
183		// Pulumi CLI Flags (Name Only)
184		flags.Visit(func(f *pflag.Flag) {
185			env["pulumi.flag."+f.Name] = func() string {
186				truth, err := flags.GetBool(f.Name)
187				switch {
188				case err != nil:
189					return "set" // not a bool flag
190				case truth:
191					return "true"
192				default:
193					return "false"
194				}
195			}()
196		})
197	}

All changes build and the existing UserAgent tests pass. Here's a summary of what I implemented:

## `pkg/backend/httpstate/client/api.go`
- Added `sync` import and package-level state (`userAgentCommand`, `userAgentAIAgent`) guarded by a mutex.
- **`SetUserAgentCommand(command string)`** — stores a sanitized command (trims whitespace, spaces/tabs → hyphens, strips `(`, `)`, `;`). E.g. `weird (cmd; with) bits` → `weird-cmd-with-bits`. Empty string clears it.
- **`SetUserAgentAIAgent(agent string)`** — stores the AI agent name; empty string clears it.
- **`UserAgent()`** — now builds `pulumi-cli/1 (<version>; <os>[; cmd=<value>][; agent=<value>])`. With nothing set it stays free of `cmd=`/`agent=` and matches `^pulumi-cli/1 \([^()]*\)$`. When both are set, output is `...; cmd=<value>; agent=<value>)` — command before agent, agent last before the closing paren.

## `pkg/cmd/pulumi/metadata/metadata.go`
- Renamed `detectAIAgent` → exported **`DetectAIAgent(getEnv func(string) string) string`** (with doc comment) and updated its internal caller. The existing detector table already covers all the required env vars (Copilot, Codex, Cursor, Gemini, Antigravity, Augment, OpenCode, Claude/cowork precedence, Replit, Goose) with `AI_AGENT` taking precedence.

Note: the existing `metadata_test.go` still references the old lowercase `detectAIAgent`, so that package's test build depends on the verification system's test patch (which I left untouched per instructions).
